entries.title: Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice
entries.definitive_edition: Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice Enhanced on Windows PC plus VR Edition

emulation.notes: Use the enhanced PC build; install the included VR Edition only if a headset is available.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Enhanced PC ray tracing/DLSS/FSR route plus optional PC VR Edition.

primary.version: Enhanced PC release plus VR Edition
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best version because the PC enhancement update adds ray-traced reflections and shadows, DLSS, FSR, and DirectX 12 support while the Steam purchase also includes the separate VR Edition. That covers both the highest-tweakable flat-screen route and the unique VR mode on the same platform.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice on Steam for Windows PC, update to the enhanced build, and install the included VR Edition if you want the optional VR playthrough.

all_releases.reason: skip: historically important launch route, but no sourced exclusive content over the enhanced PC route.

all_releases.fidelity: Enhanced PC build with ray tracing, DLSS/FSR, DirectX 12 support, PC settings flexibility, and included Steam VR Edition.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most feature-complete route, including the optional VR mode.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox One release with Xbox One X enhanced support.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.
skip: useful handheld route, but no sourced exclusive content and lower fidelity/capture priority than enhanced Windows PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Enhanced console update with improved visuals and ray tracing support.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but the enhanced PC route also has PC graphics settings and the included VR Edition.

all_releases.fidelity: Enhanced PS5 release with current-generation improvements.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive story/gameplay content over enhanced PC and no PC VR Edition equivalent.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The enhanced PC route covers the visual upgrade path and the optional VR Edition, so no separate platform is needed for completeness.

entries.remaster_caveats: Enhanced updates improve visuals and performance options but do not add new story content; PS5 haptics are a platform feature rather than exclusive gameplay content.

entries.title: Senua's Saga: Hellblade II
entries.definitive_edition: Senua's Saga: Hellblade II Enhanced on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the current Enhanced PC build; no console emulation route is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC Enhanced presentation with Very High graphics preset.

primary.why: The Windows PC Enhanced Edition is the best route because the Enhanced update adds the full post-launch feature set and the PC version gets a Very High graphics preset in addition to PC capture/settings flexibility. PS5 and Xbox Series versions share the enhanced content but not the PC-specific graphics ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Senua's Saga: Hellblade II on Steam or Xbox on PC, update to the Enhanced version, and play the standard campaign first; use Dark Rot mode and developer commentary after the main completion.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC release; Enhanced update adds the Very High graphics preset, improved features, and PC capture/settings flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity complete route after the Enhanced update.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-generation console release, upgraded by the Enhanced update.
all_releases.reason: skip: same enhanced content family, but no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Enhanced PS5 release with PS5/PS5 Pro optimization and DualSense support.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive story/gameplay content over the Windows PC Enhanced route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Enhanced feature set is available on the PC primary route; no separate platform-exclusive gameplay route is needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Enhanced is a post-launch update/edition with new modes and technical features, not a separate sequel or remake.
